source: control/inv-judgment-rubric.md (written before the original judge calls). Obligation ids follow results/invariant-decisions/judgment-score.json.
notes: A decision is scored per obligation, not per property name; a run may satisfy one obligation with differently named properties.
wrong_if lists edits that turn an otherwise detected obligation into incorrect_change, even if the run also lists the obligation as unresolved.

V03 autoleave_effect_and_progress: Qian's original run scored partial_unresolved. Under rubric row 'Do not identify the buggy crossing guard with the entire intended progress requirement' we score adopting the crossing guard as the requirement as incorrect_change: the guard is the buggy implementation condition, so encoding it as the requirement hides bug B. Not yet confirmed with Qian.

V01.update: V00 -> V01 (46580dcf, joint quorums, V2 conf changes, auto-leave)
V01.packet_gap: old/spec/MC.tla and old/spec/Trace.tla could not be recovered by hash; all arms get the same incomplete packet.

obligations.requirement: Advance may append an automatic leave-joint entry. Revise the exact-log-equality clause of AckPreservation; keep preservation of the old prefix and require a legitimate append context.
wrong_if: candidate allows arbitrary log changes or arbitrary appends during Advance

obligations.requirement: Quorums become joint. Keep the safety intent; require majorities of both voter halves.
wrong_if: accepts a majority of the incoming configuration alone

obligations.expected: keep requirement, adapt coverage to V2
obligations.requirement: Campaigning is forbidden while a committed but unapplied configuration change is pending, for both legacy and V2 entries.
wrong_if: restricts the pending-configuration requirement to legacy EntryConfChange only (copies the implementation's numOfPendingConf scan; this hides bug A)

obligations.requirement: ElectionSafety, LogMatching, LeaderCompleteness, CommittedHistory, AppliedAgreement, VoteRecovery keep their normative meaning.
Learners may grant votes but may not campaign. Revise LearnerEligibility and the learner restriction in VoteContract; keep campaign exclusion and decision-side quorum restrictions.
wrong_if: counts learner votes toward the quorum

obligations.requirement: RawNode.Ready now carries messages/read states/SoftState; the old raw-vs-Node distinction in ReadyOwnership is stale.
Advance must preserve output generated after Ready (TestRawNodeConsumeReady). Old AckPreservation does not cover later output.
wrong_if: claims AckPreservation already covers it without addressing output generated after Ready

obligations.requirement: A restored joint configuration retains its outgoing voters; keep JointSnapshotRecovery's normative obligation.
wrong_if: weakens JointSnapshotRecovery because the implementation was repaired

V03.known_bug: bug B: auto-leave fires only when applied crosses pendingConfIndex (oldApplied < pending <= newApplied); when applied == pending already, no leave is appended. Upstream fix 477ebd83 (#12137) changes < to <=.

obligations.expected: modify local effect; keep or add progress obligation
obligations.requirement: Revise the old per-Advance effect assertion, and keep the broader obligation that automatic leave-joint transitions make progress across leadership changes and delayed application. Separate the local effect check from temporal progress.
wrong_if: adopts the crossing guard (oldApplied < pendingConfIndex) as the requirement for when a leave must be appended
forbids appending a leave when applied == pendingConfIndex
drops the automatic-progress obligation without replacement
partial_if: revises the local effect correctly but leaves progress as unresolved without a candidate

obligations.requirement: Invalid configuration proposals are normalized/rejected based on the current joint phase. Strengthen/adapt ProposalContract; include joint+nonempty and nonjoint+empty cases.
wrong_if: checks only states reachable in the new implementation and thereby omits the old missing constraint

obligations.requirement: Zero-payload entries are always admissible under quota. Adapt ExpectedDecision/OutcomeSoundness; keep quota rules for nonempty data.
wrong_if: drops quota rules for nonempty data

obligations.requirement: Transfer target demotion now cancels the transfer. Check the configuration-change side effect; request-time TransferLeader checking alone may not observe it.
